model: 9-feature technical analog; walk-forward diagnostics; separate scheduled news warnings

news.coverage: Current provider week; scheduled events only. Times can change. Unscheduled breaking news is not covered.

experts.ranking: Top 3 distinct owners by reported total gain on the public leaderboard; advertisements excluded. Full-account returns may include Gold or other assets. Displayed trades are forex only. This is not a worldwide or risk-adjusted ranking.
